_note: The shot's choice (OI-88, ADR-046). Two complete actions per side of the gap: strong and placed. The actor does not choose 'shoot' and then where and how strong: he chooses one of these complete actions. power_strong and power_placed are the two powers the scene makes visible; the read does not compute the optimum. aim_edge_fraction is how near the post the aim sits (1.0 = the post). reading_weight and risk_weight modulate the salience of each action via game_reading and risk_management (L0.11 section 4.5: product, sum, clamp). ADR-050 (2026-11-12), the carrier reads what an option brings: a pass's salience is multiplied by max(progression_floor, 1 + progression_gain x appetite x (1 - pressure) x progression), where progression in [-1, 1] is how much nearer to the goal the receiver is than the carrier, appetite is his risk_management, and pressure (0..1) grows as the nearest opponent comes within pressure_radius_cm. The shot is an option within shot_range_cm, and its distance factor is 1 / (1 + (d / shot_distance_ref_cm)^2): high in the box, small but never zero from distance (it used to fall linearly to zero at 25 m). 2026-11-13 (ADR-051, measured: from 10-30 m the carrier passed back 83 times and shot 4): the goal cone is read against how the goal looks from the penalty spot (shot_cone_ref 0.6, the sine of the angle of a 7.32 m goal from 11 m), at most 1; and the shot is the end of the same intention as the forward pass (ADR-050), so its salience carries the same brings term with full progression (1 + gain x appetite x (1 - pressure)). Carry (2026-11-13, ADR-051): with room in front he may carry the ball, an option like the others: carry_salience x (room / carry_room_ref_cm, at most 1) x brings to the point the room lets him reach; the room is the distance to the nearest opponent ahead of him towards the goal. Before, carrying was only the fallback when nothing was clear, and the carrier passed as soon as he received (about 2,100 passes a match). Clear (2026-11-13, ADR-051): within clear_zone_cm of his own goal and under pressure, a carrier may kick the ball away: clear_salience x pressure x (1 - distance / clear_zone) x (1 - 0.5 x appetite): the more he is pressed and the nearer his goal, the more he clears; a cautious player clears more than a bold one. Both sides (2026-11-13): the shot is offered to both posts, the side of his other foot at other_side_factor of the salience; the keeper hides the side he covers, so the shooter can pick the far post. Before, only his foot's side existed and he shot at the keeper.
_source: Prototype. No cited figure for the four coefficients; the form follows ADR-046 (the choice is entire) and ADR-028 section 3 (arbitrary declared). To be calibrated at L3 against real shot-placement and shot-power distributions. The values are declared, not chosen: a strong shot is 0.85, a placed one is 0.35, on a 0..1 scale. ADR-050 values: arbitrary, declared, to be calibrated at L3 against real shot-distance and pass-direction distributions.
